common.failed: ❌ That didn't work, try again in a moment
common.not_in_voice: ❌ You (or the bot) need to be in a voice channel
common.voice_off: ❌ The bot's voice is turned off on this install
common.owner_only: 🔒 Only the bot's owner can do that
join.notice: 👂 **{bot}** joined the call. It listens to what's said here to react with jokes and commands. Speech is processed on the owner's computer, not by an online service. {transcripts}
join.transcripts_on: 📝 Transcripts are **on** in this server: the words of people who agreed are saved (`/transcripts` to choose, `/transcripts delete` to erase yours).
autojoin.on: 🤖 Auto-join is on: I join calls with 2+ people and leave when they empty
userclone.on: 🎭 Gags now answer in each person's own voice (for people who agreed)
userclone.off: 🎭 Gags answer in the bot's voice
consent.not_for_you: ❌ This question is for someone else
consent.voice.ask: 🎙️ **{bot}** would like to save your voice so it can imitate you in jokes. It keeps about 10 seconds of what you say in calls plus a voice print, only on the bot owner's computer. You can delete it any time with `/voice delete`.
consent.voice.accepted: ✅ Thanks! Your voice will be saved. `/voice delete` erases it whenever you want.
consent.voice.declined: 👍 Got it, nothing of your voice will be kept.
consent.transcripts.ask: 📝 This server writes down what's said in calls (transcripts), only for people who agree. Saved on the bot owner's computer. You can erase yours any time with `/transcripts delete`. Is it OK to save what **you** say?
consent.transcripts.accepted: ✅ OK, your words will be saved in servers with transcripts on. `/transcripts delete` erases them.
consent.transcripts.declined: 👍 Got it, nothing you say will be written down.
voice.deleted: 🗑️ Your saved voice was deleted and won't be collected anymore
voice.nothing_saved: 🗑️ Nothing was saved; your voice won't be collected
voice.nothing_to_rebuild: ❌ No voice to rebuild yet: agree with `/voice optin`, then talk a bit
voice.rebuilding: 🔄 Rebuilding your voice from your latest sentences
transcripts.status: 📝 Transcripts in this server: **{server}** · Your choice: **{consent}**
transcripts.on: 📝 Transcripts are on. Everyone was told, and only people who accept are written down.
transcripts.on_unannounced: 📝 Transcripts are on, but I couldn't post the notice anywhere (give me a channel I can write in). People will be asked when they speak.
transcripts.off: 📝 Transcripts are off. Nothing new will be written down.
transcripts.broadcast_on: 📝 **Transcripts are now ON in this server.** {bot} will write down what's said in calls, but **only for people who accept below**. Saved on the bot owner's computer. Change your mind any time: `/transcripts delete` erases everything of yours.
transcripts.broadcast_off: 📝 Transcripts are now **off** in this server. Nothing new will be written down.
transcripts.deleted: 🗑️ Deleted {count} saved lines of yours. Your words won't be written down unless you accept again (`/transcripts optin`).
record.on: ⏺️ Recording your own speech to testdata/ (only yours)
